# DomeBreak

> A real-time strategy game of missile defense and offense fought on the real
> world map. You run one nation: its economy, its radar and interceptor
> coverage, its arsenal, and its diplomacy with up to eleven rival powers that
> are doing the same. Free to play on macOS and Windows, single-player against
> the AI or online against other commanders.

DomeBreak is a desktop game with a companion website. The site is where an
account is created and the installers are downloaded; the game itself runs as a
native application, not in the browser.

## Pages

- [Home](https://domebreak.com/): what the game is — the world map, building
  the dome, planning a strike, and running the nation that pays for both.
- [Download](https://domebreak.com/#/download): installers for Apple Silicon
  and Intel Mac, and for 64-bit, ARM and 32-bit Windows. A free account is
  required; the download page explains the first-launch confirmation an
  unsigned application asks for.
- [Unit Wiki](https://domebreak.com/#/wiki): every unit and building in the
  game with the figures the simulation uses — cost in build points, upkeep,
  build time in game-seconds, hit points, range in kilometers, and payload.
  Grouped into missile defense, strike and offense, sensors and warning, naval,
  air wing, ground forces, command and bases, and industry.
- [Privacy](https://domebreak.com/#/privacy): what an account, a match and a
  beta application store, who else sees it, and how to have it deleted.
- [Terms](https://domebreak.com/#/terms): the licence to play, conduct in
  multiplayer, account suspension, and the limits of the warranty.
- [Contact](https://domebreak.com/#/contact): where to send a crash report, an
  account or data request, or a press enquiry, and what to put in it.

## Facts

- Platforms: macOS 10.13 or newer, Windows 10 or newer.
- Price: free. There is no purchase and no paywall.
- Nations: 222, placed on real geography.
- Powers per match: up to twelve, of which up to eleven are rivals.
- Clock: real time, pausable, running from 0.5x to 10x.
- Multiplayer: server-authoritative online matches with a lobby, parties and
  friends. Cross-play between macOS and Windows.
- Installers are served from https://download.domebreak.com.
- Made by Trenton Taylor, published under TaylorURL.
